pitch.title:
We’re not another SEO measurement site.
We’re a SEO and content coverage engine grounded in market reality.
pitch.lead: You’re not buying another report. You’re buying a way to see why a competitor is better positioned and what to do to catch up — plus you detect your strengths to make corporate decisions about them, your competitive advantages, and sector opportunities or threats you’re not addressing yet.
